## FAQ: Questions About Food Containers for Reselling
**Q: What is the minimum budget for initial stock of food containers for a culinary business?**

For a home-scale business, a budget of Rp 288.000 - Rp 480.000 is enough for initial stock of 2-3 types of containers with quantity of 100-200 pieces. Focus on the sizes you use most often for your signature menu.
**Q: How can I check if a container is truly food grade?**

Check the triangle symbol with a number at the bottom of the container. Numbers 1 (PET), 2 (HDPE), 4 (LDPE), and 5 (PP) are safe for food. Make sure there is text "Food Grade" or "BPA Free" from a certified manufacturer.
**Q: Is plastic container safe for hot food?**

PP (Polypropylene) containers are safe up to 120°C. Avoid containers with codes 3, 6, and 7 for hot food as they can release harmful substances. Always check temperature tolerance in the product specifications.
**Q: How long can food containers be stored before use?**

Plastic and aluminum containers can be stored for 2-3 years in a dry place. Paper containers should be used within 6-12 months to maintain quality. Store in low humidity areas and avoid direct sunlight.
**Q: How do I calculate container needs per day for a culinary business?**
Calculate average daily sales x 1.2 (20% buffer). Example: sell 50 portions/day = need 60 containers/day. For stock, maintain 7-14 days worth of containers to avoid running out of stock.
**Q: Is it worth investing in custom printed containers for a small business?**

Custom printing is worth it when daily sales already reach 100+ portions and profit margin is above 40%. For new businesses, focus first on product quality and service. Custom packaging can be added after brand awareness is established.
